+def _parse_version(version_string):
+    """Parse a version string into a tuple of integers (major, minor, micro)."""
+    import re
+    # Match major.minor.micro and optional pre-release/post-release info
+    match = re.match(r'(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)', version_string)
+    if match:
+        major, minor, micro = match.groups()
+        return (int(major), int(minor), int(micro))
+    # Fallback for unusual version strings
+    return (0, 0, 0)
